payload.description: Document Herdr runtime boundary and orchestrator terminology: Herdr có PaneOrchestrator hợp lệ ở Rust/UI (pane lifecycle), trong khi fgOS dispatch dùng launcher/driver/orchestrator theo nghĩa kiến trúc khác (task authority qua event log/state transition). Viết glossary/boundary note để tránh nhầm Herdr pane lifecycle với fgOS task truth. Scope: docs only -- có thể chạm docs/architect/dispatch-control-plane-redesign.md, Herdr history/docs. Acceptance: (1) nêu rõ Herdr = runtime/visibility/process control; (2) nêu rõ fgOS event log/state transition = task authority; (3) PaneOrchestrator được allowlist như Rust port term, không bị đổi mù. Verify: rg -n "orchestrator|PaneOrchestrator|Herdr" docs herdr-plugin src và mọi hit đều có nghĩa rõ/allowlisted.

payload.text: Independently confirmed 2026-08-26 (tsk-10n's own /fgOS:cook run): identical failure. tsk-10n's fgos return refused with settleClaim durable revision changed. Root cause traced live: the claim's own acquiredAt (13:44:10.968Z, from the original pick) predated a resubmit's work.add event (13:56:23.922Z, no payload.writer) after an unrelated events.jsonl loss wiped the original submit -- revisionDriftIsSelfCaused failed closed on that one unstamped event exactly as this item describes. Recovery used: manually bumped .fgos/runtime/claims/tsk-10n.json's acquiredAt past the unstamped event (user-approved), which let the self-heal reconcile on retry -- a workaround, same shape as this item's own suggested-direction (b), not a fix.

payload.text: Independently confirmed 2026-08-26 (tsk-10n's own /fgOS:cook run, ~13:44-13:56 UTC, same day as this item's own report): near-identical pattern -- fgos submit + fgos pick for a new item (tsk-10n) succeeded and was readable once (status doing, stage discovery, activeClaim intact), then within ~4 minutes fgos list --id tsk-10n started refusing not-found (exit 4) even with explicit --dir, and grep -rl tsk-10n across every .fgos/events/*.jsonl shard and .fgos/events.jsonl returned zero hits -- no shard for this session's writer id existed at all. .fgos/state.json (the derived view) had also disappeared from disk since session start (was listed as a new untracked file in the session's opening git status, gone by the time this was investigated). fgos lock-status showed the event-log lock free at read time (no live contention observed directly), and other sessions' shard files nearby show real concurrent activity on this same repo at the same time. Recovery used (worked): resubmitted the identical text (got the same deterministic id back since nothing referenced the vanished one), then fgos rebuild re-derived a matching claim from the still-intact git branch/worktree (source:branch, same claimId/acquiredAt as the original pick) -- no data was permanently lost, but the live loss-then-recovery pattern matches this item's own description exactly.
payload.rationale: third same-day live confirmation of tsk-46v's own described failure mode (after tsk-4jo/tsk-67t2), reinforces this is actively recurring not a one-off, and documents a full working recovery path (resubmit + fgos rebuild) for a future incident

payload.title: bug: dispatch.mjs execute's out-of-process JSON result can report a verifiedSha that does not…
payload.description:
bug: dispatch.mjs execute's out-of-process JSON result can report a verifiedSha that does not match the worker's own real commit, even when the commit itself lands correctly on the caller's worktree branch

Reproduced 2026-08-26 driving tsk-10n via /fgOS:cook. Called node src/runner/dispatch.mjs execute fgos-coding-implement --has-live-task-access --prompt "..." from inside worktree fgw/tsk-10n's own cwd (no --repo-root, no --cwd passed at all -- unlike tsk-322's reproduction, which explicitly passed --repo-root with no --cwd). Worker (provider agy) reported [DONE], and the actual commit (f2c475b1, correct content, correct footprint, correct branch fgw/tsk-10n, confirmed via git log -1/git status) landed exactly where it should have -- this is NOT tsk-322's wrong-commit-location symptom.

But the JSON result's own verifiedSha field read 21966be3c9bd945ac9cbec8e1b8d29823466ad7a -- which git rev-parse main confirmed was main's own current HEAD at read time ('chore(runner): revert fgos-coding-implement default from agy-herdr to agy-cli', an unrelated commit from concurrent activity elsewhere), not an ancestor of fgw/tsk-10n at all. The real worker commit (f2c475b1) is a completely different sha.

Avoided by independently verifying via git log -1/git status/git cat-file before trusting the field, and calling fgos return tsk-10n bare (no --worker-verified-sha) rather than passing the bogus sha through -- per fgos-coding-implement's own hard rule to confirm the worker's commit independently rather than take verifiedSha on faith. Had that independent check been skipped, --worker-verified-sha 21966be3... would have been passed to fgos return, which per docs/history's own return-mechanics documentation is only supposed to be used 'matching the current branch tip' -- unclear from this incident alone whether fgos return actually validates that match itself or would accept a mismatched sha silently, which is itself worth confirming as part of the fix.

Suggested directions (not prescriptive): (a) trace verifiedSha's own computation path in the dispatch/execute layer (src/runner/dispatch/cli.mjs or wherever executeExecutorCli assembles its JSON result) to find where it reads a HEAD other than the actual worktree cwd's own branch tip after the worker's commit -- likely the same repo-root-vs-cwd resolution confusion tsk-322 already flagged, but manifesting as bad metadata on an otherwise-correct commit rather than a misplaced commit; (b) confirm whether fgos return's own --worker-verified-sha handling validates the passed sha is actually an ancestor of/matches the claimed branch tip before skipping re-verification, and add that check if missing -- a caller that trusts a wrong verifiedSha today has no independent safety net.

Scope: src/runner/dispatch/ (verifiedSha computation), possibly src/runner/return.mjs or wherever --worker-verified-sha is consumed.

Verify: chưa xác định -- cần research xem verifiedSha compute ở đâu trước khi viết verify thật.
